_comment: Hard ceilings in BYTES for shipped artifacts, checked by scripts/check-size.mjs (warn locally, --strict in CI). Baselines and the ratchet discipline live in docs/perf-budget.md 'Size budget'. Ratchet DOWN as levers land; every INCREASE must be a deliberate, reviewed diff of this file. bootJsBytes = the entry chunk PLUS every chunk dist/index.html modulepreloads (the full static boot path; ratcheted 2026-08-17 to 1,040,000 after the A0 boot reclamation took the last six unclaimed surfaces lazy (BrowserPane, MemoryInspector, BookshelfView, OnboardingTour, SessionSidebar, FileViewer) with a boot-time landing-surface prefetch covering the doors — measured 1,010,988 B, ~29 KB headroom. Raised 2026-08-31 to 1,052,000 for the Front Door's harness picker: the HEAD baseline measured 1,038,732 B, i.e. 1.2 KB under the old ceiling, so the ratchet had already closed and any feature would have broken it. Measured after: 1,047,586 B, ~4 KB headroom. This was briefly 1,062,000 while the Codex plan contract was a TS module on the boot path; it moved to src-tauri/src/codex_plan_contract.txt (read by include_str! and written into the user's Codex config profile) when the inline-contract launch command turned out to exceed the 1024-byte tty input queue, which took 6.4 KB back off the entry chunk. Was 1,175,000 after MemorySurface went lazy 2026-08-14 — that lever paid for the Drafter's launch island, its blank page and the shared overlay mechanism, and the measured total AFTER all of it is 1,147,796 B, so ~27 KB of headroom remains. Was 1,210,000 with the path sitting at 99.1%). distTotalBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the viewer folded into the main build (actual 7.71 MB, dist-viewer retired). mcpBinBytes RETIRED 2026-09-07: the redline-mcp proxy is gone, the daemon serves MCP at /mcp from polis-mcp (Polis E1). binaryBytes ratcheted 2026-08-06 after the first post-profile release build (strip/thin-LTO/1cgu + the slimmer embedded dist: actual 25.66 MB, was 30.04 MB pre-profile). RATCHETED 2026-09-02 to 660,000 by the boot-path work: the feature-island split (CommentCard/ReviewPanel/ReviewDiscussionPane/ReadmeModal/FeedbackModal/HowItWorks/Invite/Join/HookSetupModal lazy in App, AgentSeats+ExtensionsPanel lazy in Header, TerminalTabs mounted after the first actionable frame) took the whole markdown-rendering stack off the boot path — the chain was App → CommentCard → CommentThread → MarkdownView → markdown-it + highlight.js/lib/common + entities + linkify-it, ~670 KB of source nothing on a cold front door needed. Measured before 1,047,586 B (99.4% of the old 1,052,000 ceiling), after 550,553 B: −47.4%. The new ceiling leaves 16.6% headroom, over the 15% the boot program set as its floor. Source-level guards for every one of those boundaries live in src/lib/sizeGuard.test.ts and src/lib/boot.test.ts — including the terminal dock, whose old invariant asserted the OPPOSITE (‘stays static — it is first paint’) and is now inverted with its reason. RAISED 2026-09-08 to 36,000,000 (from 28,000,000): the release binary had been over the old ceiling since before the Polis extraction (main @ ba3b8cf measured 30.54 MB locally, 30.39 MB on CI, so the nightly size job was already red) and the program added measured, named weight — 31.10 MB after the extraction itself, 33.82 MB when the daemon started serving MCP in-process (rmcp + its schema generator; the separate 1.5 MB proxy binary went away), 34.05 MB with the run journal and undo, 34.39 MB with the Ed25519 identity crates. The new ceiling is the measured 34,385,264 B plus ~4.5 % headroom, so the guard fails again on the next unexplained megabyte instead of never passing. The levers, for a size session: MCP mounted only when enabled or without schema generation (~2.7 MB), the second sha2 line beside the app's, and an audit of main's own pre-program overage. RAISED 2026-09-09 to 36,050,000 after independent release-budget review for the history migration/error-handling repair and chat history diagnostics/progress: the pre-repair four-plan artifact measured 35,987,600 B and the repaired artifact 36,004,416 B (whole-artifact delta +16,816 B). This bounded 50,000 B ceiling increase (+0.139%) leaves 45,584 B headroom; frontend ceilings are unchanged. Details and validation: docs/history-and-chat-repair-2026-09-09.md. RAISED 2026-09-13 to 37,700,000 after independent review of the four-plan implementation (Joey excluded): a clean same-HEAD Tauri app baseline measured 36,190,704 B, already 140,704 B above the old 36,050,000 ceiling; final embedded executable 37,467,840 B, +1,277,136 B (+3.529%) from that baseline. A shared request decoder saved 16,448 B in paired shipping builds before final capture integration. The new ceiling leaves 232,160 B (0.616%) headroom. Frontend ceilings, strict checker, panic unwind and release profile are unchanged. Measurements, build/signing distinction and review rationale: docs/perf-budget.md and docs/plan-swarm-implementation-2026-09-13.md. ADDED 2026-09-16: helperBinBytes, for the activation helper (src-tauri/crates/redline-activate). It is a SHIPPED artifact — it rides inside Redline.app at Contents/Resources/redline-activate — so it needs a ceiling like every other one, and it is separate from binaryBytes on purpose: the whole point of the helper is that it does not link the application, and the gate is what keeps that true. A dependency creeping in (reqwest, tokio, tauri) would show here as a jump of megabytes rather than as nothing at all. Measured 546,096 B on the first release build; the 800,000 ceiling leaves ~46% headroom, which is deliberate slack on a half-megabyte artifact rather than a ratchet — the number worth failing on is a different ORDER of magnitude, not a few kilobytes. RAISED 2026-09-16 to 38,500,000 for Build Redline (docs/self-develop.md). Measured on this machine, three points: a clean HEAD (260a90c) worktree built 36,190,704 B — the same number the 2026-09-13 entry above records, so the baseline has not moved; the working tree immediately BEFORE this feature measured 37,467,840 B (docs/browser-refresh-repair-2026-09-14.md §24, the four-plan work that the 37,700,000 ceiling was set for); after this feature, 38,166,656 B. Delta +698,816 B (+1.865%) for six new backend modules (runtime_profile, confine, release_manifest, probe, activation, self_develop), the shared activation-protocol crate, and the schema-v4 release table. The new ceiling leaves 333,344 B (0.866%) headroom, in line with the 0.616% the previous raise left. Frontend ceilings are unchanged and neither moved much: dist 8,363,465 → 8,383,222 B (+19,757), boot JS 589,660 → 590,037 B (+377) — the release panel rides the already-lazy Runs chunk and the readiness indicator is its own lazy island, so the boot path pays 377 bytes for a feature that builds the application. The activation helper is NOT in this number: it is a separate binary with its own helperBinBytes ceiling, which is the point of it. RAISED 2026-09-24: distTotalBytes 8,500,000 to 9,150,000 after independent review of the explicitly requested Memory Cosmos Three.js renderer. Pre-task available dist artifact 8,400,730 B; first integrated production build 8,990,298 B (+589,568). Lazy Cosmos chunk 563,609 B, worker+host+CSS 14,527 B; removing the scene chunk alone places the build below the former ceiling. The new ceiling leaves 159,702 B (1.745%) headroom on that reviewed artifact. Boot JS 599,267 B remains under its unchanged 660,000 B limit, with no Three.js in its static closure. A source guard pins the Map-only lazy boundary. Checker and all other ceilings remain unchanged. Final artifact measurements and validation: docs/twelve-plan-implementation-2026-09-24.md. RAISED 2026-10-06 for the twelve October plans (docs/plans-20261006-progress.md, docs/frontend-size-review-2026-10-06.md). binaryBytes 38,500,000 to 41,400,000: a clean worktree at main 9032117, built into the same target dir with the same toolchain, measured 39,379,952 B, already 879,952 B over the old ceiling. The branch measured 41,088,688 B, +1,708,736 B (+4.34%), for the hosted agent shell, plain-shell integration and context resolver, Guided Git (git_human, guided, sync, workspaces, narrate), browser home/organize, companion build, and the larger embedded dist. The new ceiling leaves 311,312 B (0.75%) headroom. distTotalBytes 9,150,000 to 9,450,000: baseline 9,080,628 B, branch 9,349,262 B (+268,634, +2.96%), almost all in lazy chunks (BrowserPane public-suffix list, GuidedReview, AgentShellView, ShellBlocksView, xterm serialize). 100,738 B headroom. bootJsBytes is unchanged at 660,000; the boot path measures about 99.8% of it, so the next boot-path addition needs a lever, not a raise. RAISED 2026-10-18: distTotalBytes 9,450,000 to 9,760,000 for the Flow shell (docs/perf-budget.md 'Flow shell'), which ships BESIDE classic behind the redline.shell flag until the Wave D cutover deletes classic's surfaces. Main at 445b74e measured 9,434,521 B (99.8%, so any feature would have broken it); integrate/flow at d610c1d measured 9,657,381 B, +222,860 B (+2.36%), of it 212,728 B in new lazy chunks (the conversation, stage, sidebar, start, Tools, notices) and the rest the glass and token CSS and the flow wiring in the entry chunk. The new ceiling leaves 102,619 B (1.05%), like the last raise. Ratchet it DOWN at the cutover. bootJsBytes is unchanged at 660,000: 641,981 B on main, 658,668 B with flow (99.8%). binaryBytes unchanged: 40,301,488 B on main, 40,782,624 B with flow (+481,136 B, 98.5%). RATCHETED 2026-10-28 (Workbench W6, App.tsx shrunk into workbench/panes, the adapter and the inert immersive overlay deleted, the footer a slim status bar): bootJsBytes 660,000 to 629,000 and distTotalBytes 9,760,000 to 9,625,000, each the measured figure plus a ~1.5% margin. Measured on the W6 branch rebased onto feat/workbench 77fb963: boot JS 619,640 B (618,139 B at 77fb963, +1,501 B for the static pane modules and the singleton slots now on the boot path, against the adapter, hull rail and edge reveal that left it), dist 9,482,498 B (9,484,227 B at 77fb963). Margins: 9,360 B (1.51%) on boot JS, 142,502 B (1.50%) on dist. binaryBytes and helperBinBytes unchanged (no Rust in W6). ADDED 2026-10-29: ptydBinBytes, for the terminal helper (src-tauri/crates/redline-ptyd), the process that owns the terminals so they outlive the app. It ships beside the main executable at Contents/MacOS/redline-ptyd and is budgeted apart from binaryBytes for the reason helperBinBytes is: its whole design is that it links nothing but its frame codec and libc, so a dependency creeping in (tokio, serde, portable-pty, tauri) shows here as a jump of an order of magnitude. Measured 479,200 B on the first release build (P0); the 670,000 ceiling is that plus ~40%, deliberate slack on a half-megabyte artifact, as for the activation helper.
